title: Smoke Over the Millpond | Nat 20 Pixels C1E9
description:
The barn is burning with two people inside, and the goblins who lit it are still here.
Nobody has a spell left. Somebody is going to fall.

Episode 9 of a daily pixel-art D&D 5e story. At Wending Mill, Brannoc, Ilsevel, Tamsin and Oriel fight to get the villagers out of a burning barn, and then face the one giving the goblins their orders. Death saves are real, and every one of them is rolled on screen with seeded dice: no rerolls, no fudging.

New episode every weekday. Characters, quotes and every roll are on the wiki.
